name: Kessler Optics ARC-7 AR Glasses
description:
Lightweight augmented-reality glasses with a titanium-alloy frame and photochromic lenses that shift from clear to smoke depending on ambient light. The ARC-7 overlays spatial data, comm feeds, and navigation waypoints directly onto the wearer's field of vision through micro-projected holographic layers.

Popular with couriers, fixers, and mid-tier corponation analysts who need persistent data access without the commitment of ocular augmentation. The frames accept standard neural-port adapters for enhanced bandwidth.
functionality: AR overlay, comm integration, navigation HUD
what_it_says: You need data faster than your eyes can find it, but you're not ready to let someone cut into your skull for it.
story_hooks: A pair of ARC-7s found at a crime scene contains cached AR overlays showing the victim's last navigation route — leading somewhere that doesn't appear on any public map.

physical_description.visual_profile: Sleek, minimalist eyewear with a distinctly tech-forward aesthetic. The frames sit comfortably bridging the gap between high fashion and functional equipment, suggesting both intelligence and capability. Angular titanium geometry catches light with subtle highlights.
physical_description.fit: Snug but not constrictive; sits slightly raised on the bridge to accommodate micro-projectors integrated into the frame arms. Adjustable nose pieces and temple grips ensure stability during movement.
physical_description.primary_material: Titanium-alloy frame with aerospace-grade polymer bridges. Photochromic lenses shift from optically clear to gradient smoke gray.
physical_description.texture: Frame has a brushed metallic finish with fine crosshatching for grip. Lenses are smooth glass with a faint holographic iridescence visible at shallow angles. The neural-port adapter junction on the right temple has a subtle textured grip.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray titanium with charcoal lenses. Accent highlights in pale blue (inactive HUD projection indicators) along the inner frame edge.
physical_description.closures: Friction-fit temples with micro-adjusters; no traditional closures—secured by design tension and ergonomic fit.
distinctive_features: Micro-holographic projectors embedded in frame arms
Standard neural-port adapter socket on right temple
Photochromic lens technology with gradient transition
Kessler Optics branding etched subtly on left temple
Ventilation channels along top of frame to prevent lens fogging
Minimal bezels to maximize field-of-view projection area
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2–3 professional-grade. Expensive enough to signal financial stability and technical competence, but not so exclusive as to mark the wearer as extreme wealth.
physical_description.cultural_context: Courier, fixer, mid-tier corpo analyst, data broker, or anyone who moves through the city with purpose and information at their fingertips. Signals a person who lives in augmented layers—not fully chrome, but deeply integrated with the network.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to lightly used. Professional maintenance keeps them clean and functional. Occasional micro-scratches on lenses from heavy use, but owners take pride in their upkeep.
